query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, l.description, l.content, l.is_active as lesson_is_active, l.display_order as lesson_order, c.id as chapter_id, c.title as chapter_title, c.display_order as chapter_order, s.name as series_name, coalesce((select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id), 0) as exercise_count, coalesce((select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id), 0) as quiz_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id = o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id = o.level_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where sub.name = 'Philosophie' and lv.name = 'Terminale' and s.name in ('A1', 'A2') and (l.title like 'La connaissance de%' or l.title in ('La vie en société', 'Dieu et la religion')) order by s.name, c.display_order, l.display_order limit 20;
